name: meeting-pack
title: Meeting preparation pack
for_each: select id,code as name from meetings where state='planned'

sections.title: Meeting
sections.sql: select code,name,held_on,chair,location from meetings where id=$1

sections.title: Agenda
sections.sql: select position,name,presenter,purpose,paper_ref from agenda_items where meeting_id=$1 order by position

sections.title: Board follow-up
sections.sql: select code,name,owner,due_on,status from actions where board_id=(select board_id from meetings where id=$1) and status not in ('done','cancelled') order by due_on

name: minutes-record
title: Minutes record
for_each: select id,code as name from meetings where state='held'

sections.title: Meeting
sections.sql: select code,name,held_on,chair from meetings where id=$1

sections.title: Attendance
sections.sql: select name,role,present from attendance where meeting_id=$1 order by name

sections.title: Latest minute record
sections.sql: select version,body,recorded_on,author,signed_by,signed_on,signature_ref from minutes where meeting_id=$1 order by version desc limit 1
sections.note: Recorded signature evidence is a reference, not an electronic signature service. Missing fields remain unconfirmed.

sections.title: Decision register
sections.sql: select code,name,outcome,evidence from resolutions where meeting_id=$1 order by code

sections.title: Declarations and disclosure evidence
sections.sql: select code,director,name,details,declared_on,disclosed_on,review_on,evidence from interests where board_id=$1 order by director,code
